description.value: While vulkarisu are naturally good climbers, you're exceptional, and can ascend and descend vertical surfaces without a second thought. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Combat Climber] skill feat, and you reduce the number of free hands required to Climb by one.

publication.title: Beyond the Blood Door Player's Guide
